changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 5 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

- names `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > | module | what it does | | --- | --- | | `components/src/hooks/related-count-store.ts` | related-list tab badge count | | `components/src/renderers/basic/data-list.tsx` | `element:repeater` rows | | `components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx` | `element:number` client-side aggregate | | `components/src/renderers/basic/record-picker.tsx` | `element:record_picker` options | | `plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-activity.tsx` | `record:activity` self-fetch | | `plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-history.tsx` | `record:history` self-fetch | | `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` | non-grid (kanban / calendar / gallery / timeline) fetch |

  > - `app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` — the console object page. The inline branch becomes `ganttViewOptions`, the sibling of `calendarViewOptions` and `timelineViewOptions`: the declared block spread whole, title floored at `'name'`, no date field invented. - `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — the render branch AND the capability gate. - `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — `generateViewSchema`, the authored `object-view` element route, which bypasses `ListView` entirely.

### `.changeset/7499-gantt-non-axis-floors-omitted.md`

- names `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > - `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — the `object-gantt` render branch. - `plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — `generateViewSchema`, the authored `object-view` element route, which bypasses `ListView` entirely.

### `.changeset/8653-listview-title-retired-rowactiondefs-pinned.md`

- names `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `title` — **retired.** `ListView` resolved its export filename through `schema.label || (schema as any).title`. `@objectstack/spec/ui`'s `ListViewSchema` refuses `title` **by name** (`unrecognized_keys: ['title']`) while `ObjectGridPropsSchema` **accepts** it; `packages/types` mirrors the platform contract rather than ruling over it, so declaring `title` on `ListViewSchema` would have made this repo accept what the platform save gate rejects. That asymmetry is also why objectui#6639 could take the *declare* branch for `ObjectGridSchema.title` one package over and this site could not. A parse-based census of `apps/ examples/ content/` and `packages/` found **zero** `list-view` nodes authoring `title`, so the retirement costs no author a filename. Over that same corpus the instrument reports **three** `object-grid` nodes carrying the key: **two authored** ones, both in `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md`, plus one that is not authored at all — `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` composes `title: schema.table?.title` onto a grid node it builds, so it is a producer writing the key rather than an author declaring it. `ObjectGrid`'s own `title` reads are untouched — they remain declared, ruled and read.

### `.changeset/object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.md`

- names `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` → `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` — edited by this change

  > **What was measured.** Every reading was taken on the `object-view` node renderer (`packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`, registered by `plugin-view/src/index.tsx`) with `schema.objectName` / `schema.layout` as the positive controls of the same `schema.KEY` query, so each zero is a reading; the repo-wide census of `viewTabBar` finds the key in no source file outside `@object-ui/types` (two doc tables listed it as authorable and are corrected here). The spec side was read through the installed pin (`@objectstack/spec@17.2.0`, `ui` entry, 117 exported object schemas walked; control keys `objectName` / `columns` / `navigation` / `listViews` hit): the three spec-modelled keys are optional slots on `ListViewSchema` and `ObjectListViewSchema`; the six local keys have no spec slot anywhere.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `bf7ab35ce` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1725 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2329 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36527221409)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1d75b57b5505398c08252c07672b7b259b8b4c36`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #10982 (body and all 3 comments: triage `5872794845`, claim `5883738864`, os-dev-report `5884410789`), PR #11049 (body, 5-file list, net diff against `main` at the head), and the head's check-runs with `filter=latest`. Files read at the base or the head for context only, through the contents API: `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` (base and head), `packages/plugin-gantt/src/index.tsx`, `ObjectGantt.hostDataProp-7210.test.tsx`, `ObjectGantt.emptyHostData-7333.test.tsx`, `packages/plugin-tree/src/ObjectTree.tsx` and `index.tsx`, `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx` and `index.tsx`. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

Every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, each named right or wrong:

1. **`fetchDrawsView` becomes an allow-list, `VIEW_TYPES_DRAWING_FETCHED_ROWS` = `kanban`, `calendar`, `gallery`, `timeline`, `map`.** RIGHT. The constant is module-private (not exported; the export roster of `ObjectView.tsx` is identical at base and head: `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_SPELLING`, `ObjectViewProps`, `OBJECT_VIEW_HOST_COMPOSITION_KEYS`, `OBJECT_VIEW_DECLARED_FORWARDED_KEYS`, `OBJECT_VIEW_HOST_COMPOSITION_VIEW_TYPES`, `ObjectView`). The membership is checked against the renderers, not the card:
   - `gantt` OUT is right. At the base, `plugin-gantt/src/index.tsx`'s `ObjectGanttRenderer` destructures `{ schema }` alone and renders `ObjectGantt` with `schema={bound} dataSource={dataSource}` and no other prop, so the `data` SchemaRenderer spreads never reaches the chart. `ObjectGantt.hostDataProp-7210` pins exactly this ("forwarding no other prop … the component queries for itself") and `emptyHostData-7333`'s reach note restates it ("the registered `object-gantt` renderer forwards no host prop"). The base comment in `ObjectView.tsx` ("a gantt handed zero rows is the exception … objectui#7333") described a direct caller, not the registry path this component renders through. The card's implied list was incomplete here, as the dev says.
   - `tree` OUT is right. `ObjectTree`'s fetch effect runs the `object` arm's own query (`dataSource.find` with the row ceiling and `$expand`) and `return`s before the host-rows branch (`const passed = (rest as any).data ?? schema.data`) is reached; `(rest as any).data` sits in that effect's dependency list (base line 951), which is the mechanism behind the base's extra tree query per handed array and the head's one read.
   - `chart` OUT is right. `ObjectChartProps` is closed: `schema`, `dataSource`, `onSegmentClick`. No `data` or `loading` read site exists.
   - `page`, `list`, `detail` OUT is right. `generateViewSchema` has no case for them, `renderContent` falls through to `ObjectGrid`, and the grid branch receives no `data`.
   - The five IN members are the ones the base already treated as data-fed, and nothing in the diff alters how their rows are delivered (`data={data}` on the SchemaRenderer, head line 2850, the ONE consumer of the `data` state; no callback or count exposes the fetched rows to a host).
2. **The allow-list also gates the mount / `refreshKey` fetch** (`if (!fetchDrawsView) return;` replaces the `grid`-only early return, and `fetchDrawsView` joins the effect's deps). RIGHT, and beyond the card's letter: the card names the bus subscription, but its own wording is "re-reads … for rows nothing renders", and the mount read for the same six types is the same defect in the same function. Declared by the dev as a scope deviation; the new pin asserts zero reads on mount AND on the bus for each of the six, with the inner view or grid stand-in rendered and the schema read settled, so the zero is not vacuous. Every site that moves `refreshKey` also notifies the bus, and each self-querying renderer reads the bus itself (plugin-gantt carries `ObjectGantt.invalidationRefetch-10035`), so no refresh is lost.
3. **(c) `setLoading(true)` at the top of every run becomes `setLoading(drawnRequestRef.current !== request)` immediately before `find`**, with `request = JSON.stringify([objectName, finalFilter, sort, expand])` and the ref written in the same `isMounted` block as `setData`. RIGHT. Checked in the head: there is no `await` between the effect's early returns and the `setLoading` call, so it still sets in the same tick as the base did; a superseded run writes neither `data` nor the ref; `finally` still clears `loading`; the failure path is unchanged (`console.error`, `loading` false, rows kept). A changed filter, sort, expansion or object still paints the placeholder (pinned as a control). One consequence beyond the card's bus case: a `refreshKey` move with the same request (own write, `onMutation`) is also a re-read and keeps the rows, which is what the direction asks ("keeps the current rows on screen until the new ones arrive") and is pinned by the `onMutation` case. The permissions-settle second run (expand narrows, request changes) still paints the placeholder exactly as at the base; not the card's flash, not a regression.
4. **`useDataInvalidation` subscription now off for `gantt`** as well as the base's `tree` and `chart`. RIGHT, by the same measurement as 1.
5. **Comments corrected at three sites and two pins corrected** (`busReread-10887`: `gantt` moves from the re-read list to a not-re-read control through the registered renderer path via `defaultViewType: 'gantt'`; `refreshInPlace-10035`: `tree` moves to the self-fetching group with the same three assertions). RIGHT: both stand-ins modelled a renderer as drawing handed rows that the real one never draws. The card's two named lit controls stay green in the diff: the new file's first-load-paints-placeholder control, and `busReread-10887`'s other-object / no-object controls, which no hunk touches.
6. **The `find` params stay an inline object literal** (head lines 1423 to 1436), so `no-unprefixed-query-params` and the `QueryParams` excess-property check keep reading that call. RIGHT; the head's `Lint` and `Type Check` check-runs are success.
7. **No accept-set change.** No schema, type, registry input, prop or export moves; the diff's public effect is fewer requests and no placeholder on a re-read, both inside `@object-ui/plugin-view`.

Gate verdicts on the head, read from the check-runs: `Lint`, `Type Check`, `Build & E2E`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Overwrite Report`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Inert vi.mock Specifier Check`, `Control Byte Scan`, `Shell Escape Residue Scan`, `Pre-Install Import Graph Check`, `README Export Check`, the Doc and Skill checks, `Bundle Analysis`, `Build Docs`, `Live E2E (informational)`: all **success**. `dependabot` and the coverage lanes: skipped (not applicable). `Test (shard 1/8)` through `Test (shard 8/8)` and `Spec Main Shape Gate`, in progress when this review began, all concluded **success** before the verdict was rendered, and the `Test` rollup that followed them is **success**: 43 check-runs on the head, none pending, none failed.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/10982-objectview-reread.md` declares `'@object-ui/plugin-view': patch`. RIGHT: the diff publishes no new or changed export, prop, type, schema or registration input; both halves are behaviour fixes to a producer inside the one package. Each claim in the changeset body checks against the diff and the base: the deny-list read of `gantt` and the case-less types (base `fetchDrawsView` plus the `grid`-only early return), the tree's second query on a handed array (`ObjectTree` deps, base line 951), and the calendar flash (base `setLoading(true)` on every run with `loading={loading}` passed down). The `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Claim Re-read` and `Changeset Declaration` check-runs are success.

`Clause-②: no` — carried on the PR body and on the claim comment with its "why no" (a wasted request and a loading flash go away; no published type, schema or accept set moves). RIGHT.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev flags (the os-dev-report's `deviations`), each answered:
